title: Chicken Tagine with Olives and Preserved Lemon
description: Chicken cooked down with saffron, ginger, and a whole preserved lemon until the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon. Salty, sour, and barely sweet.

ingredients.name: saffron
ingredients.note: crumbled into a little warm water

steps.text: Pound the garlic to a paste with a little salt, then work in the ginger, paprika, turmeric, bloomed saffron, and olive oil.
Rub the chermoula into the chicken thighs and leave them to take on colour.
steps.tip: An hour is better, overnight better still.

steps.text: Brown the chicken skin-side down in a heavy pot, then lift it out.
Soften the onions in the same fat until collapsing and sweet.
Return the chicken, pour in the chicken stock, cover, and simmer.
Add the preserved lemon rind and green olives and cook uncovered so the sauce reduces and thickens.
steps.tip: Taste before adding any salt — the lemon and olives already brought plenty.
